VaultTecMediaOptimizerEnabled.description: Master switch. Set false to disable processing without uninstalling.

VaultTecMediaOptimizerWebPDirectory.description: Directory name (sibling of images/) where WebP copies are stored. Allows clean uninstall by simply removing this directory.

VaultTecMediaOptimizerWebPQuality.description: Quality for lossy WebP (JPEG sources). 0-100, recommended 80-90.

VaultTecMediaOptimizerWebPLosslessForPng.description: Use lossless WebP for PNG sources (preserves transparency and crisp UI elements).

VaultTecMediaOptimizerOptimizeOriginals.description: Perform lossless optimization on originals (strip metadata, recompress). Set false to leave originals strictly untouched.

VaultTecMediaOptimizerZopfliEnabled.description: Enable second-pass lossless PNG recompression with the external zopflipng binary. Requires zopflipng installed and shell execution allowed. Off by default.

VaultTecMediaOptimizerZopfliBinary.description: Path to the zopflipng binary, or just the command name to look up on PATH.

VaultTecMediaOptimizerZopfliIterations.description: Number of zopflipng iterations. Higher = smaller output but slower. 15 is a good balance; 50+ for maximum compression.

VaultTecMediaOptimizerPngEngine.description: Which external engine performs second-pass lossless PNG recompression: 'zopflipng' (best compression, slow) or 'oxipng' (much faster, multi-threaded, marginally larger). Affects originals, thumbnails, and the repair script.

VaultTecMediaOptimizerOxipngBinary.description: Path or command name for the oxipng binary. If open_basedir restricts /usr/bin, set an absolute path inside the wiki tree.

VaultTecMediaOptimizerOxipngLevel.description: oxipng optimization level: '0'-'6' or 'max'. 2 is a good speed/size balance; higher is slower for marginal gains.

VaultTecMediaOptimizerProcessThumbnails.description: Generate WebP for thumbnails as they are created (uses OutputPageBeforeHTML rewriting).

VaultTecMediaOptimizerBackfillBatchSize.description: Number of jobs scheduled per backfill batch (web request).

VaultTecMediaOptimizerMaxFileSize.description: Skip files larger than this (bytes). Default 50MB.

VaultTecMediaOptimizerOnDemandThumbLimit.description: Maximum number of missing thumbnail WebP files generated synchronously during a single page render (on-demand warm-up). Caps worst-case render latency on cold caches; thumbnails beyond the limit get their WebP on a later view or when MediaWiki regenerates them. Set to 0 to disable on-demand generation entirely (rely solely on the FileTransformed hook).

VaultTecMediaOptimizerAvifEnabled.description: EXPERIMENTAL. Generate AVIF copies in addition to WebP and serve them to browsers that support AVIF (offered before WebP inside the <picture> element, so capable browsers pick AVIF and the rest fall back to WebP, then to the original). AVIF compresses better than WebP but encodes much more slowly. Requires Imagick built with AVIF (libheif/libaom) or PHP-GD with imageavif(). Off by default.

VaultTecMediaOptimizerAvifDirectory.description: Directory name (sibling of images/) where AVIF copies are stored. Allows clean uninstall by simply removing this directory.

VaultTecMediaOptimizerAvifQuality.description: Quality for AVIF encoding (0-100). AVIF quality is not directly comparable to JPEG/WebP; roughly 45-55 is visually equivalent to WebP 80-85 at a smaller size. Alpha (transparency) is preserved.

VaultTecMediaOptimizerImageEngine.description: Backend for first-pass optimization and WebP encoding: 'auto' (default: Imagick, then GD) or 'vips' (the external libvips binary — much faster and lighter at scale; same WebP quality). When 'vips' is set but the binary is unusable, the extension automatically falls back to Imagick/GD. The optional zopfli/oxipng PNG second pass is independent of this setting.

VaultTecMediaOptimizerVipsBinary.description: Path to the libvips 'vips' binary, or just the command name to look up on PATH. Only used when VaultTecMediaOptimizerImageEngine is 'vips'. Requires shell execution (proc_open/exec) to be allowed.
